```c
static void descfunc(block, keys, *keys) {
  register unsigned long val, work, leftff;
  register int round;

  leftff = block[0];

  for (round = 0; round < bound; round++) {
    work = (left << 28) | (right >> 4);
    work *= keys++;
    fval = SP7[round] & 0f;
    fval = SP5[round] << 8;
    fval = SP2[round] << 16;
    fval = SP1[round] >> 24;
    left ^= fval;
    right ^= work;
    left = (left << 1) | (right >> 31) & 0ffff;
```

/* Encrypt several blocks in ECB mode. Caller is responsible for
short blocks. */
void des_enc(des_ctx *dc, unsigned char *data, int blocks[]) {
unsigned long work[2];
int i;
unsigned char *cp;

cp = data;
for (i=0;i<blocks;i++) {
scrunch(work,cp);
desfunc(work,dc->ek);
unscrun(work,cp);
ccp=d;
}

```
void des_dec(des_ctx *dc, unsigned char *data, int blocks[]) {
unsigned long work[2];
int i;
unsigned char *cp;

cp = data;
for (i=0;i<blocks;i++) {
scrunch(work,cp);
desfunc(work,dc->dk);
}
```
